get.description:
Return cost and usage breakdown for the last N days.

Breaks down total spend and request volume by day, endpoint,
namespace, and model. Used to power the frontend Analytics page.
All figures are derived from the usage_log table written by
FinOpsMiddleware.

Prerequisite: namespace is only accurate after the cache-hit namespace
fix (bug 1.2) — rows written before that fix carry namespace='global'.

parameters.description: Number of days to look back
parameters.name: days

schema.description: Number of days to look back
schema.title: Days

get.description:
Return all platform constants the frontend needs to render correctly.

Namespaces, budget limits, rate limits, guardrail thresholds, and
agent defaults are all derived from config.py at request time —
there is no caching, so the frontend always gets the live values.
Decisions of the caller's tenant, newest first, with filters and a keyset cursor.

get.description:
Requests, tokens and cost from `usage_log`, by principal and by day, plus the gateway denials by kind.

`usage_log` has no principal column, so each row is attributed through the `gateway_decisions` rows that
share its request id. A request with no such row has no principal and is left out of `by_principal`.
